appName.message: ByeAI: Block AI on the Web
appName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and in chrome://extensions

appShortName.description: Short extension name shown when space is limited

appDescription.message: Block AI on web pages: chat widgets, copilots, Google AI Overviews, AI search summaries. Allow any site with one click.
appDescription.description: Extension summary in the Chrome Web Store

actionTitle.description: Default tooltip on the toolbar icon

popupBlockAiTip.message: Stops AI features from loading on websites: chatbots, copilots, AI search summaries, and AI service calls.

popupOnThisPageTip.message: AI loaders blocked on this page right now.

popupInTotalTip.message: Everything ByeAI has blocked since you installed it.

popupTipBanner.message: Site acting weird? Try allowing AI on this site.

popupReloadBanner.message: Reload this page so AI can load.

popupAllowOff.message: Block AI on this site again

popupAllowTip.message: Lets this website use AI. Other sites stay protected.

optionsTagline.message: Bye, AI until you allow it.

optionsWelcomeIntro.message: ByeAI blocks AI features on websites before they load — chat widgets, copilots, Google AI Overviews and other AI search summaries, "Ask AI" panels, and background AI service calls. Like an ad blocker, but for AI.

optionsWelcomeBullet2.message: Click the ByeAI icon to see what was blocked on the current page.

optionsWelcomeBullet3Html.message: Use Allow AI on this site when you actually want a site's AI features.

optionsWelcomeBullet4.message: Site acting weird? Allow AI on that site or turn ByeAI off from the popup.

optionsWelcomeNoteHtml.message: ByeAI does not scan your text or images. It only stops AI tools from loading.

optionsAllowedIntro.message: Sites where you chose to allow AI. Remove one to start blocking there again.

optionsStatsResetConfirm.message: Reset the total blocked counter to zero?

optionsPrivacyVsIntro.message: What ByeAI actually stops, in plain language.

optionsPrivacyVsRealText.message: Stops AI scripts and API calls before they run. Used for chat widgets, copilots, and AI service connections on most sites.

optionsPrivacyVsGoogleText.message: Switches results to Web mode and blocks known AI fetch URLs. This reduces AI on the page, but Google still receives your search query like normal search.

optionsPrivacyVsUiText.message: Hides AI boxes that still appear on screen. This is mainly so you do not see them. Network blocking does the heavy work.

optionsPrivacyVsNote.message: ByeAI does not scan your text or images. It does not make browsing anonymous. For stronger search privacy, use a search engine you trust or turn ByeAI off where you need full site features.

optionsPermissionsIntro.message: ByeAI needs access to websites you visit so it can block AI loaders before they run. Settings and allowed sites are stored locally on your device.

optionsPermissionsDnrHtml.message: declarativeNetRequest: block known AI widget and API URLs

optionsPermissionsStorageHtml.message: storage: save your settings and allowed sites

optionsPermissionsTabsHtml.message: tabs: show stats for the page you are viewing

optionsSupportIntro.message: ByeAI is free and ad-free. If it has saved you from one too many AI chat boxes, you can chip in to keep it that way.

optionsSupportNote.message: Donations are voluntary and optional. The extension will always work without one.

optionsPrivacyIntro.message: ByeAI blocks known AI loaders using a local rule list. Your browsing history is not sent to us. Allowed sites and stats are stored on your device only.
